C# — Devices and Networks

Reconstructor-type and internal-temperature queries are available only on camera models and firmware that provide those APIs. Unsupported operations return a failure result.

This page covers SDK version information, camera details, temperature monitoring, camera discovery, and IP configuration.

API Reference

GetSDKVersion()

Purpose: Returns the current SDK package version without connecting to a camera.

Parameters: None

Returns: string?, for example 4.0.0.

GetInfo / GetInfoAsync

Purpose: Returns the camera identity, firmware version, network address, model, and default image size.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

string

Camera address.

timeout

int

Request timeout in milliseconds; Default: 2000.

Returns: ApiResponse<EpicEyeInfo>?.

GetReconstructorType / GetReconstructorTypeAsync

Purpose: Returns the camera reconstruction type, including monocular, binocular, and binocular with a color camera.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

string

Camera address.

timeout

int

Request timeout in milliseconds; Default: 2000.

Returns: The synchronous method returns ApiResponse<ReconstructorType>?, while the asynchronous method returns ApiResponse<ReconstructorType>. An unsupported camera returns a failed response.

GetTemperatureInfo / GetTemperatureInfoAsync

Purpose: Returns the camera’s internal temperatures. The optional 60-second camera cache reduces repeated sensor access during health monitoring.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

string

Camera address.

useCache

bool

Whether to use cached data; Default: true.

timeout

int

Request timeout in milliseconds; Default: 2000.

Returns: ApiResponse<IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>>. An unsupported camera returns a failed response.

SearchCamera()

Purpose: Searches for cameras on the current network and returns the result.

Parameters: None

Returns: List<EpicEyeInfo>; empty list when not found.

StartDiscovery()

Purpose: Starts continuous camera discovery. Repeated calls do not create duplicate listeners.

Parameters: None

Returns: None.

StopDiscovery()

Purpose: Stops continuous camera discovery and releases its resources.

Parameters: None

Returns: None.

GetDiscoveredCameras()

Purpose: Returns the current discovered camera list.

Parameters: None

Returns: IReadOnlyList<EpicEyeInfo>.

ClearDiscoveredCameras()

Purpose: Clears the current camera list. Online cameras are added again when rediscovered.

Parameters: None

Returns: None.

DiscoveredCamerasChanged

Purpose: Triggered when the discovered camera list changes. Call GetDiscoveredCameras() to read the latest list.

Parameters

Name Type Description

handler

Action

Event handler.

Returns: event, no return value.

SetEpicEyeIPConfig(ip, message)

Purpose: Configures the camera to use DHCP or a static IP address.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

string

Camera address.

message

EpicEyeIPConfig

Value of message.

Returns: None. Validation or request errors are reported through ExceptionOccurred.

ExceptionOccurred

Purpose: Reports SDK request, parsing, and timeout errors.

Parameters

Name Type Description

handler

EventHandler<EpicEyeSDKExceptionEventArgs>

Event handler.

Returns: event, no return value.

SearchCamera() returns one search result. Use StartDiscovery(), GetDiscoveredCameras(), DiscoveredCamerasChanged, and StopDiscovery() when the camera list must be updated continuously.

Example: Continuously discovered camera

using TFTech;

void PrintCameras()
{
    foreach (var camera in EpicEye.GetDiscoveredCameras())
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"{camera.IP}  {camera.SN}  {camera.Model}  {camera.Version}");
    }
}

EpicEye.DiscoveredCamerasChanged += PrintCameras;
EpicEye.StartDiscovery();

Console.WriteLine("Press Enter Stop Discovery");
Console.ReadLine();

EpicEye.StopDiscovery();
EpicEye.DiscoveredCamerasChanged -= PrintCameras;

Example: Read information and temperature

string ip = "192.168.1.10:5000";

var info = await EpicEye.GetInfoAsync(ip, timeout: 5000);
if (info.Status != 0 || info.Data is null)
{
    Console.WriteLine(info.ErrorMessage);
    return;
}

Console.WriteLine($"{info.Data.Model} {info.Data.SN} {info.Data.Version}");

var temperature = await EpicEye.GetTemperatureInfoAsync(ip, useCache: true);
if (temperature.Status == 0 && temperature.Data is not null &&
    temperature.Data.TryGetValue("cpu_celsius", out object? cpu))
{
    Console.WriteLine($"CPU: {cpu} °C");
}
